items.title: Pointer sweep evidence report
items.summary: Turn the tested pointer projection contract into a four-direction sweep report that browser QA can assert without reading combat side effects. The next real launch risk is not another aim formula; it is proving the live canvas can cover every direction after resizing and viewport scaling.
items.recipe: Add `buildPointerAimSweepReport()` and `pointerAimBucket()` to `src/systems/gameStep.js`, test all four buckets, and feed the result into debug/calibration state.

items.title: Durable input calibration memory
items.summary: Persist a local-only record when a debug run proves north/east/south/west aim coverage, then surface that status on the front door and debug HUD. This makes first-session control confidence visible without adding accounts, telemetry spend, or player-facing setup friction.
items.recipe: Add a small `inputCalibration` utility, save a completed sweep during `?debug=input`, render calibration summary in HomeV2/debug HUD, and cover the storage/status path with tests.

items.title: Controller profile memory
items.summary: Remember the last real controller profile locally so repeat QA starts from a known browser-reported type, slot, axes, and button count. The game already detects active controllers; this turns that signal into a durable feedback loop for device-specific launch checks.
items.recipe: Extend `src/utils/gamepad.js` with profile build/load/save helpers, persist the profile when polling a connected pad, and show the remembered controller profile on HomeV2.

evidence: npx vitest run src/systems/gameStep.test.js src/utils/inputCalibration.test.js src/utils/gamepad.test.js src/components/HomeV2.test.jsx -> 27/27
